import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv",parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d.actual_min.between(1,299)].copy()
ok['hour']=ok.created.dt.hour
cols=['distance_km','items','promised_min','hour']
X=ok[cols]
y=ok.actual_min>ok.promised_min
c=['distance_km','items','promised_min']
acc_fair=round(accuracy_score(y,DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3,random_state=0).fit(ok[c],y).predict(ok[c])),3)
c=c+['actual_min']
acc_leak=round(accuracy_score(y,DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3,random_state=0).fit(ok[c],y).predict(ok[c])),3)
gap=round((acc_leak-acc_fair)*100,1)
